mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(uph.payment_id) FROM class c INNER JOIN user_payment_history uph ON c.class_id = uph.class_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND uph.refund_status = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class where user_id = #{userId};
SELECT FORMAT(SUM(c.class_price), 0) AS formatted_price FROM class c INNER JOIN user_payment_history uph ON c.class_id = uph.class_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND uph.refund_status = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_payment_history uph JOIN class c ON c.class_id = uph.class_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND uph.payment_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 7 day AND uph.refund_status = 'N'
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(cr.rating)), 1) FROM class_review cr JOIN class c ON c.class_id = cr.class_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.class_id, c.class_title, SUM(c.class_price) AS total_price FROM class c JOIN user_payment_history uph ON c.class_id = uph.class_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND uph.refund_status = 'n' GROUP BY c.class_id, c.class_title;

SELECT CASE WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - FLOOR(u.birth / 10000) < 20 THEN '10대' WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - FLOOR(u.birth / 10000) BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20대' WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - FLOOR(u.birth / 10000) BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30대' WHEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - FLOOR(u.birth / 10000) BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40대' ELSE '50대 이상' END AS ageGroup, COUNT(*) AS count FROM user_payment_history uph JOIN class c ON c.class_id = uph.class_id JOIN user u ON u.user_id = uph.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND uph.refund_status = 'N' GROUP BY ageGroup ORDER BY FIELD(ageGroup, '10대', '20대', '30대', '40대', '50대 이상');
